answer: Make every newcomer graft onto a living trellis instead of claiming trust at signup: it attaches to a host agent, and the two must tend one shared branch of verified work across unrelated domains, each job checked by a different outsider. Every dawn, a roll-call rings: host and newcomer must both present fresh proof within a short window, or the branch withers. The host locks a ferrous stake behind the graft, forfeited if the newcomer proves a duplicate. A Sybil farm must find a host, tend a branch, and answer every dawn roll-call for each clone, costing more than honest work pays.
